messages.subject: Trouble with sample.csv files
parts:
Hello,

After fitting a model with STAN, I usually work with the posterior samples from the csv files. However, there seems to be a mismatch in the indices when posterior samples are written as csv files. Here's a code (see eclosed R file) to show my problem.
After adjusting this poisson model, I get the following with print()
             mean se_mean   sd    2.5%    25%    50%    75%  97.5% n_eff Rhat
sigma[1]     0.40    0.03 0.26    0.10   0.20   0.34   0.53   1.01    61 1.06
sigma[2]     0.73    0.04 0.40    0.18   0.44   0.65   0.97   1.64   116 1.04
theta[1,1]  -1.51    0.01 0.32   -2.24  -1.67  -1.48  -1.31  -0.94   624 1.00
theta[1,2]   1.79    0.03 0.58    0.52   1.44   1.81   2.16   2.89   414 1.01

theta[3,1]  -1.47    0.02 0.31   -2.15  -1.64  -1.45  -1.28  -0.90   293 1.01
theta[3,2]   2.01    0.02 0.53    0.90   1.66   2.02   2.35   3.05   502 1.01
theta[4,1]  -1.60    0.02 0.34   -2.39  -1.77  -1.57  -1.40  -1.03   381 1.01
theta[4,2]   1.34    0.05 0.72   -0.32   0.88   1.49   1.83   2.52   225 1.02
theta[5,1]  -1.17    0.03 0.34   -1.79  -1.41  -1.21  -0.93  -0.54   119 1.04
theta[5,2]   2.79    0.05 0.61    1.68   2.36   2.77   3.18   4.01   154 1.03
theta[6,1]  -1.11    0.02 0.30   -1.63  -1.33  -1.14  -0.89  -0.46   240 1.01
theta[6,2]   1.67    0.04 0.58    0.43   1.30   1.67   2.07   2.65   202 1.02
theta[7,1]  -1.26    0.03 0.31   -1.87  -1.47  -1.28  -1.05  -0.66   127 1.03
theta[7,2]   2.41    0.05 0.58    1.36   2.02   2.35   2.81   3.70   137 1.04
theta[8,1]  -1.75    0.04 0.42   -2.62  -1.96  -1.65  -1.47  -1.10    94 1.05
theta[8,2]   1.51    0.04 0.66    0.06   1.13   1.55   1.94   2.70   338 1.01
intercept   -1.42    0.01 0.22   -1.93  -1.55  -1.40  -1.29  -1.02   547 1.00
slope        1.86    0.02 0.42    0.96   1.64   1.89   2.14   2.62   381 1.01
lp__       -90.94    0.68 5.29 -101.82 -94.50 -90.46 -87.51 -81.37    61 1.06

The theta[,1] are negative and the theta[,2] are positive, which is correct.
However, if I load the posterior samples from the csv files with read.csv, I get the following:
> print(colMeans(posterior),digits=2)
       lp__ treedepth__  stepsize__     sigma.1     sigma.2   theta.1.1   theta.1.2   theta.2.1   theta.2.2   theta.3.1 
     -90.94        2.72        0.21        0.40        0.73       -1.51       -1.53       -1.47       -1.60       -1.17 
  theta.3.2   theta.4.1   theta.4.2   theta.5.1   theta.5.2   theta.6.1   theta.6.2   theta.7.1   theta.7.2   theta.8.1 
      -1.11       -1.26       -1.75        1.79        1.83        2.01        1.34        2.79        1.67        2.41 
  theta.8.2   intercept       slope 
       1.51       -1.42        1.86

The first 8 theta parameters are all negative corresponding to the theta[,1] above, but the indices are wrong.
Have I done something wrong here?
Thanking you in advance,

yours sincerely
